players.name: Laremy Tunsil

players.name: Dyami Brown

players.name: Daron Payne

players.name: Jeremy McNichols

players.name: Javon Kinlaw

players.name: Terry McLaurin

players.name: Jaylin Lane
players.note: Oct 21: Lane underwent surgery Oct. 9 to repair his fractured and dislocated ankle, and he is expected to be cleared for activities before OTAs, Tashan Reed of The Washington Post reports.
